\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 272-274 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R277-first-pass-words-from-chapters-272-274}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a race and sport.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item amazing, sure, exciting, complicated, reasonable
  \item chocolate, sweets, pasta, flour, spices
  \item a printer, ink, a blackboard, a dictionary, a file
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Amazing? (\textbf{\ar{مدهش}}, \emph{mudhish}.) Sure? (\textbf{\ar{متأكد}}, \emph{mutaʾakkid}.) Exciting? (\textbf{\ar{مثير}}, \emph{muthīr}.) Complicated? (\textbf{\ar{معقد}}, \emph{muʿaqqad}.) Reasonable? (\textbf{\ar{معقول}}, \emph{maʿqūl}.) Chocolate? (\textbf{\ar{شوكولاتة}}, \emph{shūkūlāta}.) Sweets? (\textbf{\ar{حلوى}}, \emph{ḥalwā}.) Pasta? (\textbf{\ar{معكرونة}}, \emph{maʿkarūna}.) Flour? (\textbf{\ar{دقيق}}, \emph{daqīq}.) Spices? (\textbf{\ar{توابل}}, \emph{tawābil}.) A printer? (\textbf{\ar{طابعة}}, \emph{ṭābiʿa}.) Ink? (\textbf{\ar{حبر}}, \emph{ḥibr}.) A blackboard? (\textbf{\ar{سبورة}}, \emph{sabbūra}.) A dictionary? (\textbf{\ar{قاموس}}, \emph{qāmūs}.) A file? (\textbf{\ar{ملف}}, \emph{malaff}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 275-277 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R277-second-pass-words-from-chapters-275-277}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a bride and a person.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a bride, a person, people, a party, a wedding
  \item an animal, birds, a sparrow, a giraffe, a whale
  \item a ball, a match, a team, a race, sport
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A bride? (\textbf{\ar{عروس}}, \emph{ʿarūs}.) A person? (\textbf{\ar{شخص}}, \emph{shakhṣ}.) People? (\textbf{\ar{ناس}}, \emph{nās}.) A party? (\textbf{\ar{حفلة}}, \emph{ḥafla}.) A wedding? (\textbf{\ar{زفاف}}, \emph{zifāf}.) An animal? (\textbf{\ar{حيوان}}, \emph{ḥayawān}.) Birds? (\textbf{\ar{طير}}, \emph{ṭayr}.) A sparrow? (\textbf{\ar{عصفور}}, \emph{ʿuṣfūr}.) A giraffe? (\textbf{\ar{زرافة}}, \emph{zarāfa}.) A whale? (\textbf{\ar{حوت}}, \emph{ḥūt}.) A ball? (\textbf{\ar{كرة}}, \emph{kura}.) A match? (\textbf{\ar{مباراة}}, \emph{mubārā}.) A team? (\textbf{\ar{فريق}}, \emph{farīq}.) A race? (\textbf{\ar{سباق}}, \emph{sibāq}.) Sport? (\textbf{\ar{رياضة}}, \emph{riyāḍa}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
